Build a provenance record

Source: R/provenance.R
provenance_record.Rd

Build a provenance record

Usage

provenance_record(
  method,
  method_version,
  impl_language,
  seed,
  derived_seed,
  ir_hash,
  maturity_tier,
  independence_key,
  role,
  exactness,
  timestamp_iso8601 = NULL,
  lib_versions = NULL,
  device = NULL,
  py_pins = NULL,
  trace = NULL,
  structure_variant = FALSE
)

Arguments

method

Lens method id (e.g. "dram").

method_version

Version string of the method implementation.

impl_language

"R", "C++", or "Python".

seed

Master seed from the pass.

derived_seed

Per-lens derived seed.

ir_hash

Content hash of the originating pass.

maturity_tier

One of the maturity tiers (Stage-0 SS11).

independence_key

list(family =, kernel =) (Stage-0 SS10).

role

"opinion" or "diagnostic".

exactness

"exact", "approximate", or "resampled".

timestamp_iso8601

ISO-8601 timestamp; defaults to now (UTC).

lib_versions

Optional named list of library versions.

device

Optional device string.

py_pins

Optional named list of Python pins (Tier-3 only).

trace

Optional list of per-stage outcomes.

structure_variant

TRUE if the lens fits an alternative model structure (a different likelihood or prior) rather than the canonical reference posterior. Carried so the diagnostic layer (the shared-prior evidence axis, SS9.3) and the independence registry's specification axis (SS10.1) can tell structure variants from reference-posterior lenses.

Value

A koine_provenance object.

Examples

provenance_record(
  method = "dram", method_version = "0.1.0", impl_language = "R",
  seed = 1L, derived_seed = 42L, ir_hash = "abc123",
  maturity_tier = "reference-validated",
  independence_key = list(family = "random_walk", kernel = "dram"),
  role = "opinion", exactness = "exact")
